scope: Every table and outer figure in the submitted preprint input graph, plus explicit non-tabulated result/method anchors. Source enumeration is mechanical; the interpretation, evidence mapping and dependency assessments are authored. Rows overlap and are not units of a completion percentage. This audit does not execute Lean, models or GPUs; it binds the already published study evidence.

dependencies.registry: Authors' original task/language registry: exact kernel bytes, signatures, launches, reference modules, pinned operation tables, and exported proofs. Independent programs at equal shapes cannot replace these inputs.
dependencies.harness: Original proof-agent harness and prompts, segmentation/scaffolding, tool protocol, retries, stopping rules, context compaction, model settings and usage accounting.
dependencies.runs: Original request/response and checker traces, model revisions and original hosted-model outcomes. Offline/free inference does not recover historical paid or closed-model runs.
dependencies.mutants: All 42 original mutant source files, baseline bindings, rule assignments, final-run traces and rejection-channel decisions, including independent second opinions.
dependencies.production: The ten exact adapted production sources, upstream commits, ordered rewrites/departures, argument signatures and launch metadata; nine accepted full-kernel proof projects and the rejected kernel trace.
dependencies.hardware: Original optimized kernels and numerical contracts, complete fastest-vendor baselines, H100 execution for PTX/CUDA and same-device MI300X HIP measurements. MI350X measurements cannot fill H100 cells.
dependencies.semantics: Broader instruction/readers and scalable tiled/online/combined collective proofs. The present scalar, separate shuffle and single MFMA profiles do not cover the original optimized programs.
dependencies.history: Authors' source tree and development records. An independent implementation cannot recreate historical person-days, original source-line totals or original code-sharing percentages.
dependencies.gqa_export: Authors' supplementary standalone GQA proof project and its pinned toolchain/dependencies; it was not present in the inspected manuscript archive or bounded release endpoints.
dependencies.specification: Authors' elaborated Lean module formalizations, metaprogram/reference tests, accepted shape/precision contracts and associated trusted-assumption reports.
